lore.chimes.bamboo_chimes: A hanging wind chime of hollow Bamboo. It sways and clacks in the wind, more often the stronger it blows, and rings when struck. Sneak-use it to tie it still, and use an Axe on it to carve it. An untied chime scares off nearby Phantoms.
lore.chimes.carved_bamboo_chimes: A hanging wind chime of carved Bamboo with a deeper tone. It sways and clacks in the wind, more often the stronger it blows, and rings when struck. Sneak-use it to tie it still. An untied chime scares off nearby Phantoms.
lore.chimes.iron_chimes: A hanging wind chime of Iron rods. It sways and rings in the wind, more often the stronger it blows, and when struck. Sneak-use it to tie it still. An untied chime scares off nearby Phantoms.
lore.chimes.copper_chimes: A hanging wind chime of Copper rods. It sways and rings in the wind, more often the stronger it blows, and when struck. Sneak-use it to tie it still. An untied chime scares off nearby Phantoms.
lore.chimes.amethyst_chimes: A softly glowing wind chime of Amethyst shards. It shimmers in the wind, more often the stronger it blows, and when struck. It scares off nearby Phantoms.
lore.chimes.glass_bells: A small glass wind bell. It tinkles in the wind, more often the stronger it blows, and when struck. Its tag and bowl can be dyed. It scares off Phantoms that come close.
